title: Analista Suporte Pl
description:
Analista de Suporte Pleno

Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global. Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui! Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

O Analista de Suporte Pleno será responsável por prestar suporte técnico de segundo nível aos usuários, atuando na identificação, diagnóstico e resolução de incidentes relacionados a hardware e software, além de realizar atendimentos presenciais e remotos, garantindo a continuidade dos serviços de TI e a satisfação dos usuários.

Prestar suporte técnico em ambientes corporativos, atuando na identificação e solução de problemas de hardware e software.

Realizar diagnóstico e correção de falhas em:

  • Microcomputadores
  • Smartphones
  • Totens
  • Impressoras
  • Tablets
  • Aplicativos corporativos
  • Executar a conexão de patch cord em tomadas de dados, quando necessário.
  • Aplicar soluções emergenciais até a implementação da solução definitiva.
  • Prestar suporte técnico remoto para atividades que exigem atuação local.
  • Atuar no atendimento a áreas críticas, com suporte presencial dedicado, conforme solicitação prévia.
  • Executar atividades de IMAC (Instalação, Movimentação, Adição e Mudança), conforme programação da Gestão de End User, incluindo:
  • Instalação de microcomputadores e periféricos (exceto cabeamento e equipamentos de rede);
  • Atualização de aplicativos e sistemas operacionais;
  • Instalação de sistemas operacionais e aplicação de patches conforme diretrizes da Gestão de Ativos.
  • Realizar suporte local on-site, identificando necessidades de atualização ou substituição de equipamentos.
  • Notificar gestores e a equipe de End User sobre demandas de melhoria ou troca de ativos.
  • Apoiar na distribuição de software, realizando:
  • Instalação de novos releases;
  • Atualizações de softwares;
  • Distribuição manual quando a execução remota não for possível.

Requisitos e qualificações

Ensino superior completo em áreas correlatas à Tecnologia da Informação.

Experiência prévia como Analista de Suporte ou Técnico de Suporte Nível Pleno.

Conhecimentos sólidos em:

  • Suporte a hardware e software;
  • Sistemas operacionais Windows;
  • Aplicativos corporativos;
  • Atendimento técnico presencial e remoto.
  • Experiência com atividades de IMAC.
  • Boa capacidade de diagnóstico e resolução de problemas;
  • Organização para registro e acompanhamento das atividades.

title: HR Business Partner
description:
Com mais de 6 mil funcionários em mais de 20 países, a Statkraft é uma empresa norueguesa, com ações pautadas pela ética e transparência. É líder em energia hidrelétrica internacionalmente e a maior geradora de energia renovável da Europa. O grupo produz energia hidrelétrica, energia eólica, energia solar, energia a gás e fornece aquecimento urbano.

No Brasil a empresa tem sua sede localizada na cidade de Florianópolis, em Santa Catarina (SC). Atualmente, controla 26 ativos de geração renovável no Brasil. Em novembro de 2023, a Statkraft assinou a compra da Enerfín, subsidiária renovável da espanhola Elecnor, que inclui nove parques eólicos em operação nos estados do Rio Grande do Sul e Rio Grande do Norte. Dessa forma, a empresa tornou-se uma das maiores geradoras de energia eólica do Brasil, ultrapassando a marca de 2.2 GW de capacidade instalada, entre aquisições, construções e operações no país.

A empresa é pioneira em oferecer energia renovável rastreável com garantia de origem no Brasil, certificando, por meio do I-REC (Certificado Internacional de Energia Renovável), a origem da produção de sua energia, o que garante que a operação é sustentável.

Descrição do emprego

Responsável por implementar e acompanhar processos de RH nas áreas sob sua Diretoria/Vice-Presidência, incluindo Arquitetura Organizacional, Performance & Sucessão, Comitês de Talentos, Remuneração e Benefícios, Pesquisas de Engajamento, Treinamento e Programas de Desenvolvimento. Atua como parceiro estratégico das lideranças, influenciando e apoiando a gestão para fortalecer ambientes seguros e alinhados aos valores e competências da organização.

  • Atuar como parceiro estratégico das lideranças, apoiando no desenvolvimento da gestão e engajamento das equipes;
  • Influenciar e facilitar o desenvolvimento de executivos e gestores, acompanhando planos individuais e evolução de competências;
  • Apoiar na definição e estruturação de cargos, análises salariais e estudos de remuneração para tomada de decisão;
  • Planejar e implementar ações de capacitação, desenvolvimento de lideranças e gestão de talentos (comitês, sucessão, carreira);
  • Apoiar na gestão do clima organizacional, pesquisas de engajamento e planos de ação para melhoria contínua;
  • Elaborar relatórios e books gerenciais com dados estratégicos para suporte à tomada de decisão das lideranças;

Qualificações

Graduação em Psicologia,AdministraçãoouEngenharias;

Pósgraduaçãoem áreascorrelatas ;

Sólida experiênciaem RH e seus subsistemas;

Português Brasileiroe Inglês fluentes;

Experiência no setor de energia elétricae comercializadoras.

Informações Adicionais

Conosco, você desenvolverá uma trajetória profissional com oportunidades incríveis. Isso inclui:

  • Oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional em vários níveis da organização, incluindo LinkedIn Learning, programas e ações de desenvolvimento;
  • A chance de fazer parte de uma organização verdadeiramente global, composta por profissionais competentes, inovadores e responsáveis, de diferentes países e culturas;
  • Uma cultura organizacional que cuida e respeita as pessoas, oferecendo soluções de trabalho flexíveis, princípios de equilíbrio entre vida profissional.
  • Assistência médica e odontológica para você e seus dependentes.
  • Previdência privada, com contrapartida por parte da empresa.
  • Vale alimentação/refeição.
  • Auxílio creche ou babá para filhos até 7 anos.
  • Auxílio para pais e mães com filhos com deficiência.
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas, respectivamente 6 meses e 20 dias.
  • PAS – Programa de Apoio Statkraft, serviço profissional com psicólogos, assistentes sociais, advogados e consultores financeiros.

O que é fazer parte da Statkraft?

É contribuir para um planeta mais verde e sustentável. Ser Statkraft é renovar a energia que impulsiona o mundo: uma energia limpa, inspiradora, com ética, integridade e segurança.

Fazer parte da Statkraft é inspirar pessoas a escrever a nossa história, com acolhimento e respeito à diversidade em toda a sua plenitude.

Ser parte da Statkraft é vivenciar os nossos valores, é ser competente, responsável e inovador. É ter uma comunicação aberta e transparente.

Compromisso com a diversidade

A visão da Statkraft é renovar a forma como o mundo é movido. Para navegar essa jornada complexa, precisamos de todas as vozes à mesa. Por isso, trabalhamos ativamente para ser um local de trabalho diverso e inclusivo, e damos boas-vindas a todos os candidatos, independentemente de origem, gênero, idade, orientação sexual, crença religiosa, etnia, nacionalidade ou deficiência.

Nosso processo seletivo é contínuo , o que significa que não há data limite para envio de candidaturas. Enquanto a vaga estiver publicada, seguimos avaliando novos perfis.

Para se candidatar, envie seu currículo através de nossa plataforma. Estamos ansiosos para conhecer você!

title: Product Designer (Ux/Ui)
description:
Professional English is a requirement for this role. A challenge will be required.

About Foundey

Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high‑quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early‑stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user‑centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast‑growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast‑paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands‑on product thinker with a deep understanding of user‑centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise‑grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.

Responsibilities

  • Lead end‑to‑end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high‑fidelity UI design.
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user‑centered design solutions.
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance.
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs.
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite.
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design.
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.

Requirements

  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams.
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools.
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle.
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software.
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers.
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience as a Product Designer.
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.).
  • Background in designing data‑heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role‑based user permissions.
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers.
  • Prior experience working with U.S.-based startups or product teams.
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.

Why Join Us?

At Foundey, you will work on high‑impact projects for fast‑growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You'll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting‑edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

title: Regional Sales Manager
description:
Join to apply for the Regional Sales Manager role at Autronica Fire and Security AS

At Autronica, you’re joining a leading innovator, supplier, and system integrator of fire and gas safety solutions worldwide. Our products protect lives and assets on land, at sea, and in the energy sectors. We are an international company with offices across the globe, and our HQ is located in Trondheim, Norway’s technology hotspot. Autronica’s greatest assets are the expertise, creativity, and passion of our employees – and we’re excited for you to join the team.

Do you want to be part of a highly committed team striving toward our vision of zero loss of lives, no injuries, or damages caused by fire and gas?

About the role

Autronica is seeking a Regional Sales Manager for the Energy sector to grow the company’s Fire and Security solutions across South America. In this role you will engage directly with clients, EPCs, system integrators, MEP, and other industrial land contractors, driving project wins and expanding Autronica’s presence in the region. The role covers FPSO, LNG, Clean Energy, and conventional energy projects across upstream, midstream, and downstream segments, as well as emerging markets such as Renewables.

Reporting to the Regional Sales Director, you will work to ensure alignment, sustainable growth, market leadership and ensure Autronica’s solutions continue to protect assets, people, and operations across the energy sector.

Preferred locations for the role are Rio de Janeiro or Sao Paulo, Brazil.

Responsibilities

Your responsibilities as a Regional Sales Manager will be:

Business Growth & Market Leadership

  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities with end users, EPCs, system integrators, MEP, and industrial contractors as well as explore new applications for our solutions in emerging energy markets.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships to expand market penetration and reinforce Autronica’s reputation.
  • Deliver accurate forecasts, maintain strong margins, and propose comprehensive fire and gas detection solutions.
  • Partner with global teams and across functions to engage EPCs, MEPs, engineering firms, and stakeholders and to leverage best practices and market intelligence.
  • Act as a trusted advisor and build alliances with third-party partners to strengthen market growth.
  • Develop partnerships with end-users, distributors, and industry influencers and ensure Autronica’s inclusion on Approved Vendor Lists (AVLs) and organize events with distributors.
  • Lead preparation of major bids, ensure compliance with pricing and approvals, and maximize profitability.

Compliance & Values

  • Ensure adherence to Autronica’s ethics, EHS requirements, and company policies.
  • Support continuous improvement across the region.

Who we are looking for

To be successful in this role, you’ll bring a proactive, results-driven approach and a strong commercial mindset. You combine strategic vision with hands‑on engagement, enjoy building lasting relationships with clients and partners, and thrive in dynamic, multicultural environments where you can make a real impact. You approach challenges with a problem-solving mindset, communicate with clarity and influence, and stay focused and adaptable while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, evolving market.

Qualifications and experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related field (Electronics, Electrical, Automation, Controls or relevant).
  • Diversified sales experience in technology-driven industries.
  • Solid experience in selling safety, automation, or related solutions to EPCs, MEP/contractors, system integrators, or end customers in the energy sector.
  • Established regional network and extensive regional market knowledge.
  • Proven experience in instrumentation sales within the oil & gas sector, combined with a strong track record in pursuing and winning EPC (Engineering, Procurement & Construction) projects.
  • Proficient in Salesforce or similar CRM tools for managing pipelines, forecasting, and reporting.

What we offer

  • An exciting and challenging position in a team with skilled colleagues.
  • Competitive conditions and flexible working time arrangements.
  • A professional work environment where we always strive to deliver and exceed expectations.

Our commitment to you

As an employer of choice, our greatest assets are the expertise, creativity, and passion of our employees. We strive to provide a great place to work that attracts, develops, and retains the best talent, promotes employee engagement, fosters teamwork, and drives innovation for the benefit of our customers. We aim to create an environment where you feel that you belong, with diversity and inclusion as the engine to growth and innovation. We develop and deploy best-in-class programs and practices, providing enriching career opportunities, listening to employee feedback, and always challenging ourselves to do better.

The values that guide us are respect, integrity, inclusion, innovation, and excellence.

We’re excited for you to join us and make a difference.

title: Principal ROV Specialist
description:
Job Overview

The Principal ROV Specialist interprets internal or external business issues and recommends best practices. They will be tasked with solving complex ROV (Mar)-related problems and will work independently with minimal guidance. The Principal ROV Specialist may be responsible for leading functional teams or projects and is regarded as a specialist in ROV (Mar). As such, they must have in-depth expertise in ROV (Mar) as well as broad knowledge of the ROV (Mar) discipline within the Marine function.

Essential Qualifications and Education

  • Degree in Engineering
  • Minimum 10 years in offshore remote subsea system design and operations
  • Min. 8 years of experience supporting construction projects
  • Good command of English both oral and written
  • Proficient in the use of subsea ROV & ROV tooling systems
  • Previous offshore experience
  • Proven experience working with ROVs and tooling packs
  • Willingness to travel
  • Extensive knowledge/expertise in Subsea Remote Systems design, functioning, and operation (ROV, ROV Tooling, subsea architecture, connectors, flying leads…)
  • Extensive knowledge/expertise in the design, functioning, and operation of remote subsea tooling associated with ROV and subsea hardware operation
  • Good Project Engineering skills and experience
  • Previous knowledge in dealing with ROV and Subsea EPC contractors
  • Good understanding of QHSE
  • Proficient knowledge of technical software: AutoCAD, SolidWorks, Autodesk Inventor
  • Proficient knowledge of project software: Microsoft Project, Microsoft Office

Key Tasks and Responsibilities

  • Oversee ROV requirements on assigned project
  • Oversee ROV Tooling Requirements
  • Oversee Commissioning Tooling Requirements
  • Carry out ROV access studies and checks
  • Desktop studies
  • Ensure efficient and excellent integration of the subsea interfaces of SURF project to the marine operations execution

Deliverables

  • Conduct live audits of ROV contractor's premises/offshore in conjunction with Marine QHSE and provide feedback on system and personnel performance/opportunities for improvement
  • Ensure ROV contractors comply with statutory and IMCA guidelines
  • Prepare ROV contractor mobilization audits to ensure readiness/compliance with contract specifications
  • Liaison with Clients / ROV contractors both on and offshore to confirm operational status
  • Research and assessment of latest ROV techniques/equipment so MDR remains up to date and for possible inclusion into Marine Operations/standards

Project Deliverables

  • Issue installation procedure for subsea hardware installation/operation
  • Issue equipment/material specifications for remote subsea tooling and installation aids
  • Provide expertise to the project team to review the subsea installation philosophy of the main subsea components (flexible, umbilical, suction pile, manifold, SDU, and flying lead installation) and proper implementation into the installation procedure
  • Provide input to subsea Pre-Commissioning / Commissioning activities for key contractors
  • Manage interface with subsea hardware EPC contractor and review subsea material delivered to enable a smooth integration of all supplied subsea components into the installation method
  • Ensure that the EPC Contractor meets the technical quality and timely delivery of their deliverables
  • Provide technical / construction support as part of the subsea team in dealing with key vendors
  • Participate in Installation Constructability Reviews and HAZID’s
  • Ensure that the offshore execution is performed safely, timely, and as efficiently as possible, providing quality reporting throughout the offshore period

Reports to

  • Functional: Director ROV Operations
  • Regional: MAO And Senior Manager Marine Operations
  • Project/Construction Manager when assigned to the project
  • Supervises: Ops Engineers/Field Engineers/Draftspersons
  • Liaise with: All Marine operations personnel, functional managers, Engineering design teams, project engineering, tendering teams, procurement/subcontract coordinators, and clients

Formação:

  • Superior Completo em Engenharia Química ou Engenharia de Petróleo/Mecânica.

Responsabilidades:

I. Liderança Técnica e Validação de Deliverables

  • Revisão Crítica de Documentação: Liderar a revisão e aprovação de documentos chaves da Engenharia de Processos para o detalhamento, incluindo:
    • Diagramas de Fluxo de Processo (PFDs) e Diagramas de Tubulação e Instrumentação (P&IDs).
    • Folhas de Dados (Datasheets) de Equipamentos Estáticos e Rotativos, Válvulas de Controle e Alívio (PSV/PRV).

  • Otimização e Design Review: Participar ativamente em reuniões de HAZOP, SIL/LOPA e Design Reviews para identificar e mitigar riscos operacionais e de segurança.
  • Cálculos de Processo: Realizar e/ou auditar cálculos complexos, como balanços de massa e energia, dimensionamento de linhas, sizing de vasos e trocadores de calor, e simulações termodinâmicas.
  • Gestão de Mudanças: Gerenciar e documentar alterações de escopo (Management of Change - MOC) relacionadas a processos durante a fase de detalhamento.

II. Colaboração e Interface

  • Interface Multidisciplinar: Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipes de Engenharia de Tubulação, Instrumentação, Elétrica e Civil para garantir que o layout e a interconexão dos sistemas de processo sejam viáveis, seguros e eficientes.
  • Suporte a Suprimentos: Prestar suporte técnico à equipe de Suprimentos na avaliação técnica de propostas de fornecedores de equipamentos críticos.
  • Interação com Clientes/Órgãos Reguladores: Apresentar e defender soluções técnicas de processo para o cliente e/ou agências reguladoras (se necessário).

III. Normas e Qualidade

  • Conformidade Normativa: Assegurar que todos os projetos de processo cumpram rigorosamente as normas Nacionais e Internacionais aplicáveis à indústria de O&G (Ex: API RP, ASME B31.3, NRs, DNV/ABS).
  • Padronização: Promover a padronização de metodologias e documentação para aumentar a eficiência e a qualidade nos deliverables de Processo.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência em Processos e/ou como Engenheiro(a) de Processos, atuando diretamente em projetos de Engenharia de Detalhamento para unidade de óleo e Gás (Ex: FPSOs, Refinarias, Terminals ou Plantas Petroquímicas).
  • Domínio na interpretação e geração de P&IDs e PFDs.
  • Conhecimento sólido em sistemas de segurança de processo (PSV sizing, Flare/Blowdown).
  • Proficiência em softwares de simulação de processo (Ex: HYSYS, ASPEN Plus ou PRO/II).
  • Fluência em inglês.
  • Abordagem metódica e zero tolerância para desvios de segurança e qualidade.
  • Habilidade para negociar soluções técnicas complexas e gerenciar expectativas entre as disciplinas e o cliente.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com prazos apertados e em ambientes de projeto dinâmico, típicos da fase de detalhamento.

Desejável:

  • Conhecimento aprofundado das especificações de grandes operadoras de O&G.
  • Experiência prévia em fase de FEED ou em Comissionamento/Partida de plantas.

title: Linux Cryptography and Security Engineer
description:
Linux Cryptography and Security Engineer

2 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

This is a unique opportunity to use your software engineering and cryptography skills to build and maintain the security foundation that enables Ubuntu and its users to operate securely and remain compliant to international information security standards such as FIPS 140-3 and Common Criteria. You will use your applied cryptography, Linux Security, and coding skills to enhance the Ubuntu distribution and work with organizations such as DISA and CIS to draft and implement security hardening benchmarks for Ubuntu.

As a member of the Security Hardening team you will work with and develop automation tooling to audit deployed systems for DISA-STIG and CIS benchmark compliance. You will interact with internal and external stakeholders to identify gaps in our frameworks, and develop new solutions to address these challenges. In this role you will have the opportunity to influence team and security culture, facilitate technical delivery, and help drive team direction and execution. You'll collaborate closely with Canonical's kernel team as well as the wider engineering organization to drive features impacting all Ubuntu users.

Day-to-day responsibilities

  • Collaborate with other engineers in the Security Hardening team to achieve and retain various Security certifications
  • Extend and enhance Linux cryptographic components (OpenSSL, Libgcrypt, GnuTLS, and others) with the features and functionality required for FIPS and CC certification
  • Collaborate with external security consultants to test and validate kernel and crypto module components
  • Work with external partners to develop security hardening benchmarks and audit + remediation automation for Ubuntu
  • Contribute to Ubuntu mainline and upstream projects to land solutions and benefit the community
  • Communicate and collaborate within and outside Canonical to identify opportunities to improve our security posture, rapidly resolve issues, and deliver high-quality solutions on schedule

What we are looking for in you

  • Hands‑on experience with low‑level Linux cryptography APIs and debugging
  • Excellent software engineering fundamentals, including prior experience with C development, and the ability to demonstrate such
  • Hands‑on experience with Linux system administration and shell scripting
  • Demonstrated knowledge of security and cryptography fundamentals + direct experience writing secure code and implementing best practices
  • Significant development experience working with open source libraries
  • Excellent verbal and written communications to enable efficient collaboration with internal and external partners in a remote‑first environment

Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring

  • Prior experience working on FIPS/Common Criteria certified products and in‑depth knowledge of the underlying standards
  • Prior experience working directly with DISA‑STIG or CIS benchmarks, including related audit + remediation tooling (e.g. Compliance as Code)
  • Experience working directly with Linux Kernel
  • Prior experience with Python, OVAL (Open Vulnerability Assessment Language), and Ansible
  • History of contributions to open source projects

What we offer you

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence – in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote‑first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st‑century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
Responsável por assegurar o desenvolvimento e a gestão das infraestruturas técnicas necessárias para as atividades de cobrança, controlando o processo de cobrança, analisando periodicamente as contas para identificar aquelas que podem requerer procedimentos de cobrança especiais e atuando também nos processos de governança que envolvem a cadeia de cobrança.

Principais atividades

  • Controlar todos os processos da cadeia de Cobrança, com objetivo de garantir a aderência as regras de negócio implementadas e o monitoramento fim a fim de todas as etapas da régua de cobrança;
  • Gerenciar as bases faturadas Vs. Ações de cobrança, mapeando os principais ofensores/oportunidades garantindo a qualidade;
  • Realizar auditorias sobre todas as ações da régua de cobrança, com o objetivo de identificar os principais ofensores em toda cadeia de cobrança e assim atuar junto a TI na solução das inconsistências;
  • Controlar o processo de No Dunning (isenção de cobrança), com o objetivo de garantir a governança desta carteira e seus respectivos motivos, por meio de relatórios e processos de auditoria;
  • Realizar controles SOX da cadeia de Cobrança;
  • Analisar reclamações ANATEL, sobre as ações de cobrança, com o objetivo de identificar as oportunidades sobre os processos sistêmico da cadeia, garantindo a melhoria contínua e redução do índice de reclamações de Cobrança na ANATEL;
  • Controlar todo processo de negativação, tendo interação direta com os fornecedores de Bureaus de Crédito;
  • Desenvolver relatórios que possibilitem o melhor controle da cadeia de cobrança;
  • Participar de War Room junto a TI, para tratar os temas relacionados a cadeia de cobrança;
  • Automatizar processos e Relatórios;
  • Elaborar apresentações executivas;
  • Segmentar listas de contato por perfil e objetivos das ações multicanal;
  • Realizar análises sobre o desempenho nos diferentes canais de contato de cobrança;
  • Monitoramento de métricas como taxa de abertura, cliques, conversões e rejeições;
  • Gerar insights com base nos dados coletados para melhoria contínua;
  • Criar dashboards e relatórios periódicos para acompanhamento de performance.

Requisitos e qualificações

Conhecimento, Experiência e Formação

Job description

A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Concessionária

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com apromoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Assistente Contábil

BHub Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Sobre a oportunidade

Como Assistente Contábil na BHub espera-se que você seja responsável por garantir que as conciliações contábeis estejam corretas, bem como analisá-las e preparar as demonstrações financeiras mensais e anuais. Cabe à pessoa assistente elaborar relatórios de pendências, apuração e elaboração de controles adicionais. Exerça suas atividades com maior autonomia e domínio do conhecimento contábil, buscando a informação de forma proativa.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Conhecimento técnico para a realização da contabilização e movimento financeiro;
  • Boa gestão do tempo e organização para conferir e revisar a documentação mensal da empresa;
  • Olhar crítico para validar integração dos módulos contábil, fiscal, folha e patrimônio;

Requisitos

  • Ensino superior completo/em andamento em Ciências Contábeis;

  • Experiência em rotinas contábeis;

  • Disponibilidade para atuar no modelo híbrido (cerca de 2x na semana presencial na unidade do Rio de Janeiro/RJ).

Benefícios

  • Credencial plena no Sesc;

Empresa

Somos uma empresa de processamento operacional que combina tecnologia e especialistas para assumir a parte contábil, financeira e administrativa das empresas. Empreendedores e empresários contábeis simplificam suas operações, reduzem burocracias e ganham mais tempo para focar no que realmente importa. Nossa tecnologia e expertise otimizam processos, tornando a gestão contábil e financeira mais eficiente e estratégica. Conectamos contadores ao futuro da contabilidade, oferecendo soluções tecnológicas que ampliam seu valor consultivo e potencializam o crescimento dos clientes!

Diversidade & Inclusão

Queremos um ambiente onde nossas pessoas sejam diversas e sintam-se estimuladas e felizes. Também é importante sonhar o nosso sonho, assim como ter brilho nos olhos, vontade de aprender e crescer, gostar de ajudar e buscar por excelência e inovação no serviço.

Cultura e Desenvolvimento

Aqui na BHub acreditamos em autonomia de verdade, conversas diretas e um ambiente onde todo mundo consegue contribuir. Nada de camadas infinitas ou processos engessados — gostamos das coisas simples, rápidas e transparentes. Nosso jeito de trabalhar é colaborativo, aberto a feedbacks e com muito espaço para testar, ajustar e aprender ao longo do caminho. Crescemos juntos, celebramos pequenas conquistas e mantemos um clima leve, onde você pode ser quem você realmente é enquanto constrói impacto real.

Política de Proteção a Dados

Os dados que você informar no formulário do processo seletivo são confidenciais e estão armazenados em ambiente seguro. Nós adotamos medidas técnicas e administrativas aptas para proteger os seus dados. Para exercer os seus direitos sobre os seus dados pessoais, como acesso aos dados, confirmação de tratamento, correção dos dados, anonimização, bloqueio ou eliminação e outros direitos com a BHub, entre em contato com a gente por Para saber mais sobre como tratamos os dados pessoais no BHub acesse nossa Política de Privacidade.

title: Video Strategist
description:
Join to apply for the Video Strategist role at Launch Potato

2 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is a profitable digital media company that reaches over 30M+ monthly visitors through brands such as FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. As The Discovery and Conversion Company, our mission is to connect consumers with the world’s leading brands through data-driven content and technology. Headquartered in South Florida with a remote-first team spanning over 15 countries, we’ve built a high-growth, high-performance culture where speed, ownership, and measurable impact drive success.

WHY JOIN US?

At Launch Potato, you’ll accelerate your career by owning outcomes, moving fast, and driving impact with a global team of high-performers.

Note: This is a contract-to-hire position

MUST HAVE:

  • Demonstrated experience driving video performance, engagement, and watch time, ideally in a revenue-focused environment
  • Strong understanding of video syndication platforms (MSN preferred) and how they reward engagement
  • Hands-on experience with scriptwriting, editing feedback, and video optimization
  • Comfort managing freelancers, assigning work, and overseeing quality and deadlines
  • Ability to analyze performance metrics and translate insights into actionable improvements
  • Strong organizational skills and comfort juggling multiple projects at once
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in a remote environment
  • Willingness to experiment, test, and iterate quickly
  • Openness to incorporating AI tools into scripting, ideation, and workflow optimization

EXPERIENCE: 3+ years in video strategy, video production, or performance-driven video roles within digital media, performance marketing, or content monetization. Personal finance experience or familiarity strongly preferred.

YOUR ROLE

You’ll own the strategy, planning, and performance of FinanceBuzz’s video content, with a primary focus on syndication platforms (especially MSN) where revenue is driven by consumed seconds of video. Secondarily, you’ll support video publishing and optimization for YouTube and social platforms. This is a highly hands-on role. You’ll be directly involved in topic selection, scripting, editing feedback, thumbnail and on-screen graphic optimization, and performance analysis. Your goal is simple but ambitious: scale video revenue significantly over time while maintaining high-quality, trustworthy personal finance content. To succeed in this role, you’ll need strong instincts for what keeps viewers watching, comfort working with performance data, and the ability to manage multiple contributors and workflows at once. You should be equally comfortable zooming out to plan a content roadmap and zooming in to rewrite a script or leave frame-by-frame feedback. This role is contract-to-hire and will play a key role in growing video from its current state (~$15K/month) into a $500K+ annual revenue stream.

SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Selecting video topics that consistently maximize viewer engagement, watch time, and revenue
  • Optimizing scripts to increase retention, clarity, and completion rates
  • Improving thumbnail and on-screen graphic performance through testing and iteration
  • Building and maintaining an efficient, scalable video workflow
  • Managing freelancers effectively: assigning work, giving clear feedback, and coordinating payments and budgets
  • Maintaining high quality and brand consistency across all video content
  • Monitoring video performance metrics and proactively identifying opportunities for improvement
  • Growing video revenue from its current level toward a $500K+ annual run rate
  • Establishing FinanceBuzz as a trusted and engaging personal finance video brand

Core Responsibilities

  • Own the video content strategy for syndication platforms, with a primary focus on MSN
  • Plan and maintain the video content calendar
  • Write, edit, and optimize video scripts
  • Provide detailed feedback to video editors and designers
  • Optimize thumbnails, titles, and on-screen graphics for engagement
  • Oversee video production workflows for speed, quality, and consistency
  • Manage freelance contributors and coordinate with internal stakeholders on budgets and payments
  • Conduct quality control on all video outputs
  • Track and report on video performance metrics and revenue

COMPETENCIES

  • Performance-Driven: Obsessed with engagement, watch time, and revenue outcomes
  • Detail-Oriented: Catches issues before they go live and pushes for constant improvement
  • Strategic & Tactical: Thinks big-picture while staying deeply involved in execution
  • Ownership Mentality: Treats the video business as their own and takes responsibility for results
  • Adaptable: Thrives in a fast-changing environment and adjusts strategy based on performance data
  • Collaborative: Works closely with editorial, design, and operations partners
  • Coachability: Welcomes feedback and actively seeks ways to improve systems and output

description:
Drilling Foreman – Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package

Join to apply for the Drilling Foreman – Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package role at Aramco

This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full-time Expat Relocation Package.

Job Overview

We are seeking a Drilling Foreman to join the Unconventional Resources Drilling Operations Division (URDOD) of the Unconventional Resources Drilling Department (URDD). The URDOD has direct field responsibility for the drilling or working over of wells located anywhere in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and its territorial waters as specified in the well drilling or workover program.

Key Responsibilities

  • Supervise work on wells below 15,000 feet or wells complicated by pressure above 10,000 psi, sour gas, highly deviated, or that cost in excess of $10,000,000.
  • Fiscal accountability for Saudi Aramco‑owned equipment and materials, timely communications with Drilling Operations headquarters and logistical coordination of transportation services, materials movement, well services (Saudi Aramco and contractor supplied), water support and roads/location support.
  • Perform unit‑level supervisory function at well locations remote to Operations headquarters on a 24‑hour per day basis, 28 days on duty, 28 days off work schedule.
  • Direct all well operations efficiently, safely and according to accepted industry practices as outlined and specified in the well drilling or workover program issued by the Drilling Engineering Dept.
  • Coordinate timely ordering of required well materials, equipment and services according to the well program. Document receipt, usage and transfer of Saudi Aramco supplied materials and equipment. Review service company field tickets for accuracy of services provided and associated charges.
  • Ensure that Saudi Aramco Blowout Prevention Standards are met in all respects including equipment configuration, testing and crew response. Assure that rig and personnel comply with Saudi Aramco established safety standards and procedures.
  • On rigs contracted to Saudi Aramco, assure compliance with terms, conditions and equipment/personnel as specified in the Contract.
  • Provide headquarters a complete daily report of work progress as required in the Daily Morning Report.
  • Promote cost‑saving ideas and awareness with the view toward operational optimization consistent with safely meeting well objectives.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering from a recognized and approved program.
  • 9 years’ experience related to the drilling and/or workover of oil and gas wells.
  • Ability to provide on‑job training to less experienced drilling/workover personnel assigned to the rig.

Employment Details

  • Seniority level: Mid‑Senior level
  • Employment type: Full‑time
  • Job function: Engineering, Strategy/Planning, and Management
  • Industry: Oil and Gas

Descrição e Responsabilidades

Você irá desenvolver e liderar a estratégia do funil de crescimento e de melhoria contínua do retorno sobre investimento das ações de captação de recursos de MSF-Brasil, maximizando a contribuição para os projetos médico-humanitários da organização pelo mundo. Irá trabalhar para encantar, conquistar e fidelizar pessoas doadoras por meio de engajamento contínuo, diversificando canais e garantindo a sustentabilidade do programa de captação de recursos de MSF-Brasil a longo prazo.

Além disso, deverá desenvolver e incentivar estratégias ousadas, inovadoras, orientadas por dados e que reforcem a marca de MSF, fomentando uma relação com pessoas doadoras pautadas pela ética e transparência, visando sempre a segurança e privacidade de dados. Atuando em estreita colaboração com outras lideranças, garantindo uma abordagem alinhada com a estratégia de MSF-Brasil como um todo e assegurando que o crescimento seja conduzido de forma ética, inclusiva e responsável, considerando a diversidade de públicos, contextos e impactos das estratégias adotadas.

Quais serão seus desafios?

  • Ampliar a base de pessoas doadoras ativas de MSF-Brasil, buscando caminhos inovadores para enfrentar os diferentes desafios no mercado e considerando cada etapa do funil de crescimento;
  • Aumentar a receita de MSF-Brasil, garantindo eficiência nas atividades de crescimento e buscando maximizar Retorno sobre Investimento (ROI);
  • Promover cultura de captação de recursos na organização, equilibrando crescimento, inovação e performance com decisões éticas, inclusivas e alinhadas aos valores institucionais.

Como é o dia a dia da posição?

Atividades de Crescimento e Estratégia

  • Zelar pela qualidade das entregas da célula, junto aos responsáveis das áreas, garantindo o atendimento às demandas com qualidade;
  • Assegurar que os processos de compras, pagamentos e reports são cumpridos pela célula de acordo com os prazos definidos;

  • Garantir experimentação e implementação de novos canais e abordagens para expandir alcance e performance junto às lideranças da célula e em colaboração estreita com o time de Business Intelligence (BI);
  • Garantir otimização constante da experiência de pessoas usuárias, Régua de Relacionamento e atendimento a pessoas doadoras, zelando pela qualidade de cada contato e considerando abordagem inovadora e omnichannel;

  • Trabalhar com líderes na célula para melhorar processos e fluxos junto às outras células no hub de Engajamento Estratégico em busca de melhor eficiência e agilidade nas atividades;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com o time de Filantropia no planejamento e implementação de estratégias para desenvolver pessoas doadoras, tanto pessoas físicas quanto jurídicas, visando aumentar suas contribuições e direcioná-los à categoria de grandes doações, com atendimento personalizado pela equipe de Filantropia;
  • Garantir potencial de otimização da área de sistemas junto a Gerência de Sistemas e GTT através de investimentos em novas tecnologias;
  • Garantir que a célula de crescimento contribua e segue processos de certificação de PCI compliance de MSF e segurança de dados conforme LGPD e políticas de MSF;
  • Negociar as melhores condições de parceria de fornecedores de MSF-Brasil junto as lideranças na célula;
  • Contribuir para projetos de alto nível do Hub de Engajamento Estratégico, conforme necessário;
  • Desenvolver e liderar a estratégia do funil de crescimento de MSF-Brasil, envolvendo as áreas interessadas e garantindo participação ativa de suas equipes na construção;
  • Definir, sustentar e responsabilizar-se pela incorporação de princípios de diversidade, equidade e inclusão nas estratégias, decisões, prioridades e práticas da célula de crescimento, influenciando lideranças, equipes e parceiros e promovendo um ambiente seguro, ético e coerente com os valores de MSF;
  • Garantir participação e acompanhamento de plataformas internacionais relevantes para MSF-Brasil, trazendo ideias inovadoras e adaptando para o cenário brasileiro;

Promoção de cultura de Captação de Recursos

  • Ser responsável pela construção de uma cultura de captação de recursos em MSF-Brasil, garantindo a consistência dos programas oferecidos para as pessoas funcionarias, conscientizando a organização sobre a importância de captação de recursos e relacionamento com as pessoas doadoras;
  • Compartilhar insights e performance da área com outros departamentos da organização continuamente, assegurando trabalho transversal;
  • Participar e contribuir com o fórum de ONGs no Brasile plataformas internacionais, trazendo insumos relevantes do mercado e ideias inovadoras, adaptando para o cenário de MSF-Brasil;
  • Influenciar a cultura organizacional para que práticas de captação e relacionamento sejam compreendidas e realizadas de forma ética, inclusiva e alinhada aos valores institucionais;

Compromissos de gestão de MSF-Brasil

  • Atuar de forma alinhada aos valores e princípios da organização, promovendo uma gestão de pessoas ética, equitativa e inclusiva, que valorize a escuta ativa, fomente uma cultura de feedback contínuo e incentive o desenvolvimento profissional;
  • Aplicar e disseminar as diretrizes éticas de MSF-Brasil e os Compromissos Comportamentais da organização, assegurando um ambiente de trabalho respeitoso, transparente e coerente com os princípios da organização;
  • Favorecer a colaboração entre áreas e o trabalho transversal, desenvolvendo e aprimorando processos integrados com olhar estratégico;
  • Contribuir ativamente para o Planejamento Estratégico e Plano Anual, participando de monitoramentos periódicos, identificando riscos e ajustando prioridades com responsabilidade e visão sistêmica;
  • Garantir a implementação e promoção ativa de práticas de Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão (DEI), valorizando diferentes perspectivas, combatendo qualquer forma de discriminação e promovendo um ambiente seguro para todas as pessoas;

Promoção de cultura ágil e contribuição para mudança

  • Adotar metodologias ágeis, incentivando ciclos curtos de entrega, aprendizado contínuo e adaptação às mudanças;
  • Estimular a criatividade e a experimentação, propondo soluções inovadoras e ousadas que ampliem a relevância e o engajamento de MSF-Brasil junto ao público brasileiro;
  • Basear e incentivar decisões em dados e evidências, fortalecendo a transparência, a eficiência e o foco em resultados;
  • Atuar como agente de mudança no processo de transformação do Hub, contribuindo para a implementação de novas formas de trabalhar, incluindo cultura data-driven e metodologia ágil.

Requisitos

  • Formação relevante na área;
  • Sólida experiência em liderança de crescimento e captação de recursos;
  • Experiência com gestão de pessoas e canais diversos de marketing;
  • Domínio do inglês (avançado);
  • Conhecimentos de estratégia de marketing e análise de resultados, propostas, tendências;
  • Conhecimentos de metodologia ágil e gestão de projetos;
  • Conhecimentos de CRMs, bancos de dados e Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (LGPD);
  • Conhecimentos de Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão e aplicação em liderança.

As Vantagens de Ser um (a) Especialista em MSF?

  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em áreas relacionadas;

title: Principal ROV Specialist
description:
Job Overview

The Principal ROV Specialist interprets internal or external business issues and recommends best practices. They will be tasked with solving complex ROV (Mar)-related problems and will work independently with minimal guidance. The Principal ROV Specialist may be responsible for leading functional teams or projects and is regarded as a specialist in ROV (Mar). As such, they must have in-depth expertise in ROV (Mar) as well as broad knowledge of the ROV (Mar) discipline within the Marine function.

Responsibilities

  • Oversee ROV requirements on assigned project
  • Oversee ROV Tooling Requirements
  • Oversee Commissioning Tooling Requirements
  • Carry out ROV access studies and checks
  • Desktop studies
  • Ensure efficient and excellent integration of the subsea interfaces of the SURF project to the marine operations execution

Deliverables

  • Conduct live audits of ROV contractor's premises/offshore in conjunction with Marine QHSE and provide feedback on system and personnel performance/opportunities for improvement
  • Ensure ROV contractors comply with statutory and IMCA guidelines
  • Prepare ROV contractor mobilization audits to ensure readiness/compliance with contract specifications
  • Liaison with Clients / ROV contractors both on and offshore to confirm operational status
  • Research and assessment of latest ROV techniques/equipment so MDR remains up to date and for possible inclusion into Marine Operations/standards

Project Deliverables

  • Issue installation procedure for subsea hardware installation/operation
  • Issue equipment/material specifications for remote subsea tooling and installation aids
  • Provide expertise to the project team to review the subsea installation philosophy of the main subsea components (flexible, umbilical, suction pile, manifold, SDU, and flying lead installation) and proper implementation into the installation procedure
  • Provide input to subsea Pre-Commissioning / Commissioning activities for key contractors
  • Manage interface with subsea hardware EPC contractor and review subsea material delivered to enable a smooth integration of all supplied subsea components into the installation method
  • Ensure that the EPC Contractor meets the technical quality and timely delivery of their deliverables
  • Provide technical / construction support as part of the subsea team in dealing with key vendors
  • Participate in Installation Constructability Reviews and HAZID’s
  • Ensure that the offshore execution is performed safely, timely, and as efficiently as possible, providing quality reporting throughout the offshore period

Reporting Structure

Reports to:

  • Functional: Director ROV Operations
  • Regional: MAO and Senior Manager Marine Operations
  • Project/Construction Manager when assigned to the project

Supervises: Ops Engineers/Field Engineers/Draftspersons

Liaises with: All Marine operations personnel, functional managers, Engineering design teams, project engineering, tendering teams, procurement/subcontract coordinators, and clients

Qualifications

  • Degree in Engineering
  • Minimum 10 years in offshore remote subsea system design and operations
  • Min. 8 years of experience supporting construction projects
  • Good command of English both oral and written
  • Proficient in the use of subsea ROV & ROV tooling systems
  • Previous offshore experience
  • Proven experience working with ROVs and tooling packs
  • Willingness to travel
  • Extensive knowledge/expertise in Subsea Remote Systems design, functioning, and operation (ROV, ROV Tooling, subsea architecture, connectors, flying leads…)
  • Extensive knowledge/expertise in the design, functioning, and operation of remote subsea tooling associated with ROV and subsea hardware operation
  • Good Project Engineering skills and experience
  • Previous knowledge in dealing with ROV and Subsea EPC contractors
  • Good understanding of QHSE
  • Proficient knowledge of technical software: AutoCAD, SolidWorks, Autodesk Inventor
  • Proficient knowledge of project software: Microsoft Project, Microsoft Office

About Us

Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we’ve forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing platforms hundreds of miles from shore, using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure, and reshaping the onshore landscape to deliver the energy products the world needs safely and sustainably.

For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries.

Role Overview

We are looking for a high-impact creative who operates at the intersection of Direct Response, Design, and Generative AI creative production (video and static). This role goes far beyond “making ads.” You will be responsible for building high‑converting creative systems using the latest AI tools, combined with strong design fundamentals, prompt engineering, and a critical human touch in post‑production.

The ideal candidate has 5+ years of design experience and understands that while AI tools speed up production, results come from strategy, structure, and execution. You will work closely with Designers and the Media Buying team and own the full lifecycle of creative assets, from UGC‑style video concepts and static ads to high‑intent landing pages designed in Figma.

Key Responsibilities

  • AI‑Driven Video & UGC Production
  • Conceptualize and storyboard UGC‑style video flows for creators and AI video engines.
  • Generate high‑fidelity video assets using platforms such as Nano Banana and Veo.
  • Refine AI‑generated outputs into final ad units by adding overlay text, promotional graphics, CTAs, captions, and platform‑specific formatting.
  • Static Creative & AI Image Generation
  • Create brand‑aligned static imagery using Midjourney or similar tools.
  • Import and refine AI‑generated assets in Figma or Adobe Creative Suite, applying strong typography, branding, and direct‑response principles.
  • Develop and maintain AI prompt design systems to ensure consistency across campaigns.
  • Performance Design & CRO
  • Design mobile‑first, high‑converting landing pages that maintain strong message match with ad creatives (Figma, Unbounce, ClickFunnels).
  • Collaborate with the Media Buying team to analyze CTR, CVR, and performance data.
  • Rapidly iterate on creatives based on insights and results.
  • Plan and execute A/B tests on key visual elements to improve ROI.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Experience working with AI creative tools such as Midjourney, Nano Banana, Veo, or similar, with a clear workflow for integrating AI outputs into design tools.
  • Advanced proficiency in Figma with a strong understanding of layout, typography, and visual hierarchy. Strong direct response mindset and understanding of what makes ads convert on Meta, TikTok, and similar platforms.
  • Ability to produce and iterate on high volumes of creative variations without sacrificing quality or originality.
  • A strong portfolio showcasing both video (UGC / AI‑generated) and static creatives, ideally with performance or conversion impact.

Our Stack

  • Figma, Adobe Creative Cloud
  • Nano Banana, Veo
  • Midjourney, DALL‑E 3
  • Unbounce, ClickFunnels, Webflow
  • Meta, TikTok, Reddit, Google

Why This Role

This is a full‑time role for someone who wants to be at the forefront of how modern advertising is built. You will act as the creative lead of an AI‑powered production system, focused on strategy, speed, and performance rather than manual execution.

Canonical is a leading provider of open‑source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world’s leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable and growing. We are hiring Python and Kubernetes Specialist Engineers focused on Data, Workflows, AI/ML and Analytics Solutions to join our teams building open‑source solutions for public cloud and private infrastructure.

As a software engineer on the team, you’ll collaborate on end‑to‑end data analytics and MLOps solutions composed of popular, open‑source machine‑learning tools, such as Kubeflow, MLflow, DVC, and Feast. You may also work on ETL, data governance and visualization tools like Apache Superset, dbt, workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow and Temporal, or data‑warehouse solutions such as Apache Trino or ClickHouse. These solutions may be run on servers or on the cloud, on machines or on Kubernetes, on developer desktops, or as web services.

We serve the needs of individuals and community members as much as the needs of our Global 2000 and Fortune 500 customers; we make our primary work available free of charge and our Pro subscriptions are also available to individuals for personal use at no cost. Our goal is to enable more people to enjoy the benefits of open source, regardless of their circumstances.

Location: This initiative spans many teams that are home‑based and in multiple time zones. We believe in distributed collaboration but we also try to ensure that colleagues have company during their work hours! Successful candidates will join a team where most members and your manager are broadly in the same time zone so that you have the benefits of constant collaboration and discussion.

What your day will look like

  • Develop your understanding of the entire Linux stack, from kernel, networking, and storage, to the application layer
  • Design, build and maintain solutions that will be deployed on public and private clouds and local workstations
  • Master distributed systems concepts such as observability, identity, tracing
  • Work with both Kubernetes and machine‑oriented open source applications
  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team of engineers, designers and product managers
  • Debug issues and interact in public with upstream and Ubuntu communities
  • Generate and discuss ideas, and collaborate on finding good solutions

What we are looking for in you

  • Professional or academic software delivery using Python
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above‑and‑beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite and effective in a multi‑cultural, multi‑national organisation
  • Thoughtfulness and self‑motivation
  • Result‑oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long

Additional skills that would be nice to have

The following skills may be helpful to you in the role, but we don’t expect everyone to bring all of them.

  • Proven track record of building highly automated machine‑learning solutions, data pipelines, or orchestrating workflows for the cloud.
  • Hands‑on experience with machine‑learning libraries, or tools.
  • Experience with container technologies (Docker, LXD, Kubernetes, etc.)
  • Experience with public clouds (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
  • Working knowledge of cloud computing
  • Passionate about software quality and testing
  • Experience working on an open‑source project

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance‑driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person

  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave

  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence – in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

title: Estoquista
description:
Estoquista líder em operação de e-commerce

Buscamos um profissional para atuar como Estoquista líder em operação de e-commerce , responsável por gerir todo o ciclo de armazenagem, controle de inventário e expedição de pedidos de vendas online (marketplace, loja virtual, etc.). O objetivo é garantir eficiência operacional, precisão de inventário e atendimento ágil para os clientes.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar todas as operações de estoque: recebimento, armazenagem, separação (picking), embalagem (packing) e expedição de pedidos online.
  • Manter o controle e a acuracidade do inventário, realizando conferências periódicas, inventários cíclicos e auditorias de estoque.
  • Planejar níveis de estoque com base em vendas, sazonalidade, previsões de demanda e análise de giro de produtos — evitando rupturas ou excesso de estoque.
  • Coordenar a logística de expedição e distribuição, garantindo que pedidos sejam processados, embalados e enviados corretamente e dentro dos prazos.
  • Gerenciar devoluções, trocas ou reembalagens, garantindo tratamento eficaz a casos de retorno de mercadorias.
  • Liderar, treinar e supervisionar a equipe de estoque/almoxarifado — definindo rotinas, distribuindo tarefas, mantendo organização e produtividade da operação.
  • Implementar e otimizar processos internos (fluxos de recebimento, separação, expedição, conferência, inventário), buscando agilidade, precisão e eficiência operacional.
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com áreas como compras/abastecimento, logística, atendimento ao cliente e vendas para garantir alinhamento entre estoque, demanda e entregas.
  • Acompanhar e reportar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) como acuracidade de estoque, tempo de processamento de pedidos, taxa de erros, produtividade da equipe, níveis de cobertura, turnover de produtos, entre outros.

Requisitos / Perfil Desejado

  • Experiência prévia com gestão de estoque, almoxarifado ou operações logísticas — especialmente em ambiente de e-commerce ou distribuição para vendas online.
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de gestão de estoque, WMS, controles de inventário e ferramentas de ERP/gestão logística.
  • Capacidade de planejamento e análise de demanda/estoque (previsão, abastecimento, rotação de produtos, sazonalidade).
  • Habilidade em liderar e gerenciar equipes, com boa comunicação, organização e visão de processos.
  • Perfil proativo, orientado a resultados, com foco em eficiência, qualidade e melhoria contínua de processos.
  • (Desejável) Experiência com gestão de devoluções/retornos, logística reversa e operação de expedição para e-commerce.

description:
Descrição

Acompanhar e apoiar as atividades de soldagem realizadas pela equipe, auxiliando também o mecânico em reparos e manutenções. Executar serviços de soldagem e corte em peças metálicas utilizando diversos processos (eletrodo revestido, TIG, MIG, MAG, oxigás, arco submerso, brasagem, plasma), preparando os equipamentos, acessórios e materiais necessários. Garantir a qualidade dos serviços, seguindo rigorosamente as normas de segurança, organização do local de trabalho e preservação do meio ambiente.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar desmontagem e montagem de equipamentos, utilizando ferramentas específicas para reparo e substituição de peças, com o objetivo de melhorar o desempenho e prolongar a vida útil dos mesmos.
  • Auxiliar diariamente nas atividades de soldagem, distribuindo as tarefas entre os colaboradores, definindo prioridades e oferecendo suporte técnico, garantindo a correta execução dos serviços.

  • Avaliar eventuais danos causados a navios por equipamentos da empresa, e, quando constatada a responsabilidade, realizar os reparos necessários de forma ágil, evitando atrasos nas operações portuárias.

Associate Director of Research Administration

Posted 6 days ago – apply early to be among the first 25 applicants.

What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, vision insurance and mental health support.
  • Work-Life balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements.
  • Financial wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match.
  • Professional development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, career advancement paths.
  • Additional perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, vibrant company culture.

Basic Function

The Associate Director of Research Administration will oversee the College Research Administrators (CRAs) and departmental research administrators, ensuring effective pre‑ and post‑award support for faculty. The role includes training, oversight, and performance evaluation of research administrators across all colleges, and serves as the primary liaison between the Office of Research (OOR) and Associate Deans to improve administrative efficiency and ensure compliance.

Supervisory Authority

Primary point of contact for CRAs and departmental research administrators, providing strategic oversight, training, guidance, recruitment, and onboarding.

Nature And Scope

Reporting directly to the Director of Research Administration or AVP of Research Operations, the Associate Director implements a centralized research administration model, establishes standardized workflows, ensures ongoing training, and leads monthly research administration meetings.

Principal Accountabilities

Oversight & Management

  • Directly supervises CRAs and departmental research administrators.
  • Works with Deans, Associate Deans, and PIs to enhance grant support services.
  • Develops standardized departmental processes for pre‑ and post‑award administration.
  • Integrates existing departmental research administrators into the new structure.

Training & Professional Development

  • Creates onboarding program for new and transitioning administrators.
  • Ensures all administrators complete 12 hours of required training annually covering proposal development, budgeting, Workday Grants workflow, and federal compliance.
  • Leads monthly 3‑hour research administration meetings for updates, training, and issue resolution.

Performance Management & Feedback

  • Collaborates with Associate Deans to assess performance.
  • Develops metrics to track effectiveness across colleges.
  • Addresses faculty concerns and seeks process improvement opportunities.

Collaboration & Troubleshooting

  • Acts as liaison among CRAs, departmental administrators, Associate Deans, SPO, and Research Operations.
  • Resolves grant setup, payment, budgeting, and compliance issues.
  • Coordinates with HR and Procurement to streamline hiring and financial workflows.

Compliance & Policy Implementation

  • Keeps administrators current on federal, state, and institutional policies.
  • Provides guidance on changes in grant regulations (NIH, NSF, DoE, 2 CFR 200, etc.).
  • Monitors practices for adherence to university and federal requirements.

Core Competencies

  • Strong leadership across multiple colleges.
  • Expertise in pre‑ and post‑award research administration.
  • Advanced knowledge of federal grant regulations and institutional policies.
  • Effective problem‑solving and workflow streamlining.
  • Excellent communication and training skills.
  • Collaborative mindset with cross‑stakeholder experience.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, research administration, public administration, finance, or related field.
  • Minimum 7 years of research administration experience (pre‑ and post‑award).
  • Knowledge of federal funding agency policies (NIH, NSF, DoE, DOD).
  • Experience supervising and training research administrators.
  • Proficiency with Workday Grants or similar ERP, federal compliance, and university-sponsored programs.
  • Demonstrated leadership and process improvement abilities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certified Research Administrator (CRA) or Certified Pre‑Award Research Administrator (CPRA).
  • Experience in an R1 university or large research-intensive institution.

Position Summary

The Chief Operating Officer (COO) of the Howard University Faculty Practice Plan (FPP) serves as the senior operational leader responsible for the strategic, financial, and administrative oversight of the physician enterprise. The COO ensures that all ambulatory and faculty practice operations function efficiently and are aligned with the mission of Howard University and its academic health enterprise.

The COO partners closely with the CEO/Executive Director of the FPP, clinical department chairs, practice administrators, hospital leadership, and the College of Medicine to drive performance, expand access, strengthen the patient experience, and support the clinical, educational, and research missions.

Operational Leadership of the Physician Enterprise

  • Provide executive oversight of all ambulatory clinics, faculty practices, and related clinical operations.

  • Ensure that clinical operations meet standards of safety, quality, service excellence, and regulatory compliance.
  • Implement consistent operational policies, workflows, and performance standards across departments and practice sites.

Strategic Planning & Growth

  • Develop and execute strategies to support practice expansion, new clinical programs, and service line growth.
  • Assess market and demographic trends to inform future planning and provider network development.
  • Partner with university and hospital leadership to align practice operations with broader academic and clinical priorities.
  • Support recruitment planning, provider onboarding, and optimization of clinical FTE utilization.

Provider Access, Productivity & Performance Optimization

  • Lead initiatives to improve provider productivity, panel management, template design, and clinical capacity utilization.
  • Partner with department chairs and practice leaders to set and monitor operational KPIs (e.g., access metrics, cycle time, provider productivity, patient satisfaction).
  • Support performance review processes, compensation model implementation, and incentive alignment.

Financial & Revenue Cycle Management

  • Collaborate with the CFO to manage operating budgets, financial forecasts, and profitability of service lines.
  • Provide operational leadership for revenue cycle functions (e.g., registration, scheduling, charge capture workflows, documentation optimization, denial reduction).
  • Work with central revenue cycle leaders to ensure clean claims, timely billing, and improved collections.
  • Evaluate and optimize payer mix, managed care leverage, and ambulatory financial performance.

Systems, Technology & Data Integration

  • Oversee optimization of the electronic health record (EHR) and other clinical information systems to support efficient workflows.
  • Ensure accurate, real‑time dashboards and data analytics to drive decision‑making.
  • Champion the use of technology, automation, and digital health solutions to improve access and patient engagement.

Regulatory, Compliance & Quality Oversight

  • Ensure operational compliance with CMS, Joint Commission, ambulatory accreditation standards, HIPAA, OSHA, and related federal and local regulations.
  • Partner with quality leaders to strengthen ambulatory quality and patient safety programs.
  • Lead operational readiness for audits, surveys, and accreditation activities.

Leadership, Culture & People Management

  • Build and develop high‑performing administrative and operational teams.
  • Promote a culture of equity, accountability, service excellence, and continuous improvement.
  • Provide coaching, mentorship, and leadership development to practice managers and administrative staff.
  • Strengthen physician–administrative partnerships across departments.

Collaboration with Academic & Hospital Partners

  • Work closely with the College of Medicine to align clinical operations with teaching and training needs.
  • Coordinate with Howard University Hospital leadership to ensure smooth inpatient–outpatient continuum of care.
  • Assist in integrating residents and students into clinic operations in compliance with accreditation requirements.

  • Work‑Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements

  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Qualifications

Education

  • Master’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, Public Health, or a related field required.

Experience

  • Minimum 10 years of progressive leadership experience in an academic medical center, faculty practice plan, or large multispecialty physician group.
  • Strong experience in ambulatory operations, physician enterprise management, and performance improvement.
  • Demonstrated success improving access, financial performance, and operational efficiency across multiple clinical departments.
  • Experience in a mission‑driven, culturally diverse, urban healthcare environment preferred.

Skills & Competencies
